product_one_liner.value: Safety Cloud sends real-time digital alerts through connected vehicles and navigation apps to warn drivers of emergency vehicles and roadway hazards, serving public-safety agencies and roadway fleets.
product_one_liner.notes: HAAS Alert describes Safety Cloud as a collision-prevention service delivering real-time warnings about nearby emergency vehicles and roadway hazards, and states it serves public-safety agencies and roadway fleets.

pricing_page.notes: HAAS Alert has a public page titled Safety Cloud Pricing, which presents pricing options and a device price.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: HAAS Alert's case-study pages identify DC Fire and EMS Department and WJ Group as organizations using Safety Cloud. | named_customers.0: The D.C. Fire and EMS case study names the department and describes its adoption of Safety Cloud. | named_customers.1: The WJ Group case study names WJ Group as an adopter of Safety Cloud.

employee_band.notes: Built In Chicago reports 70 total employees, which falls in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The headquarters address given for HAAS Alert is in Chicago, Illinois, United States; the requested city is Chicago. | hq_country: The listing identifies the address as HAAS Alert Global Headquarters in Chicago, Illinois, United States.

founded_year.notes: Volition Capital's HAAS Alert portfolio page explicitly says the company was founded in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The company's media/blog index lists audience-facing roadway-safety and V2X explainers by its team and leadership (for example, distracted-driving and V2X policy topics), rather than multiple engineering-authored posts about building the product; the indexed posts do not establish a technical engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The public HAAS Alert Knowledge Base has a General FAQ index with numerous separate product and help articles, meeting the requirement for several public documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists RevOps Manager/GTM Engineer, Product Manager, and Technical Delivery & Solutions Lead; none of the open role titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role under the stated title criteria.

model_provider.notes: I checked the public product-help articles, Trust Center/security FAQ, blog index, and privacy disclosures for a named model or AI provider; these sources discuss the product, security, and general third-party-provider categories but do not identify a model provider or subprocessor by name.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company's Trust Center names SOC 2 Type 1/2 and SOC 3, ISO/IEC 27001, and GDPR compliance; among the requested categories these support SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center explicitly names SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center names ISO/IEC 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center explicitly lists GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company calls the latest funding event a $50,000 Scale Grant, and the funding-history page labels the last round Grant. | funding_date: The latest listed grant was announced and recorded on April 17, 2026, yielding the requested YYYY-MM value 2026-04. | funding_amount_usd: The company announced receipt of a $50,000 Scale Grant on April 17, 2026; Caplight independently lists the April 17, 2026 grant as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The announced $50,000 grant is dated April 17, 2026, inside the 18-month period preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists RevOps Manager/GTM Engineer, Product Manager, and Technical Delivery & Solutions Lead, with no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: HAAS Alert announced the launch of Safety Cloud for Android Automotive on June 2, 2026, which falls within six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brock Aun's profile records his HAAS Alert Chief Strategy Officer/CxO role starting in July 2026, within the requested 12-month window; it shows his preceding VP of Product role ending at that time, so this is a move into the C-suite rather than a new hire to the company.
